subject: Mythology
title: Vishnu: The Preserver
description: A short lesson to help you apply Vishnu: The Preserver.

hook.text: Whenever the universe falls into crisis, Vishnu descends to earth in a new form to restore cosmic balance.

buildup.text: He has ten avatars, including a fish, a turtle, a boar, and two of the most beloved gods in Hinduism.

discovery.text: Rama and Krishna are both avatars of Vishnu, born as humans to defeat evil and teach righteous living.

twist.text: His tenth avatar, Kalki, has not appeared yet. Hindus believe he will come at the end of the current age.

climax.text: Vishnu sleeps on a cosmic serpent between creations, dreaming the next universe into existence.

punchline.text: He saves the world by becoming part of it, again and again.

quiz.question: What are Rama and Krishna in Hindu mythology?
options: Sons of Brahma who guard the heavens
Avatars of Vishnu born to defeat evil on earth
Independent gods unrelated to the great trinity
